purpose: Preregistered rerun of posteriordb_bench_v1 on the current main sampler with fresh seeds: default-settings comparison of oWALNUTS (dual averaging, JMLR Appendix C v4, opt-in Stan-style warmup) with CmdStan NUTS and nutpie on the same 17 posteriordb posteriors; measures whether the post-v1 fixes (non-STAN_THREADS BridgeStan build + ReplicatedStanTarget, recoverable NaN/inf evaluations, Stan-style start retries, depth 10 default, v4 robust paper rule) close the gaps recorded in v1.

predecessor.artifacts_reused: none (summary.json read only for the v1-vs-v2 comparison table)

owalnuts-da.target: owalnuts-bridgestan ReplicatedStanTarget, 4 replicas (BridgeStan 2.9.0, Stan 2.39.0, built WITHOUT STAN_THREADS, fresh compile for this study)
owalnuts-da.starts: sampler::Init::uniform(): uniform(-2,2) unconstrained, redrawn up to 100 times until finite density and gradient; SmallRng(splitmix64(seed ^ INIT_SEED_TAG))

warmup.contents: mean-trajectory acceptance statistic, Stan initial step search, Stan metric regularisation, Stan restart reference mu = ln(10 h), delta = divergence threshold during the initial 75-transition phase

nutpie.backend: bridgestan (nutpie.compile_stan_model; nutpie builds its own STAN_THREADS library)

run_order: models in listed order; arms owalnuts-da, owalnuts-paper, owalnuts-stan-style, cmdstan, nutpie; seeds ascending; strictly sequential
parameter_set: columns of the posteriordb reference draws; oWALNUTS draws constrained by BridgeStan param_constrain(include_tp=True)
estimators: arviz 0.23.4: rank rhat; bulk ESS; tail ESS prob (0.05, 0.95); mcse method mean

metrics.gradients_total: owalnuts target calls (start search + warmup + sampling, all chains); cmdstan sum n_leapfrog__ (warmup+sampling); nutpie sum n_steps (warmup+sampling)
metrics.wall: seconds around the single sampler call (Sampler::run, CmdStanModel.sample, nutpie.sample), warmup included, compile excluded; the oWALNUTS start search (a handful of evaluations) is outside the wall
metrics.wall_sampling_estimated: wall * gradients_sampling / gradients_total (all arms); cmdstan CSV elapsed times also recorded
metrics.ess_per_second: min over parameters of bulk (tail) ESS / wall
metrics.ess_per_gradient: min over parameters of bulk (tail) ESS / gradients_total; sampling-only variant also reported
metrics.agreement: z = (mean - mean_ref)/sqrt(mcse^2 + mcse_ref^2) with arviz mean MCSE on both sides; max |z| over parameters; flag if > 4
metrics.frozen_chain: an oWALNUTS chain with more than 500 of its 1,000 retained transitions ending in refinement exhaustion; a cell is frozen if any chain is

head_to_head: per (owalnuts arm, competitor): geometric mean over models with all seeds ok on both sides of the seed-median ratios of min bulk ESS/gradient, min bulk ESS/s and wall per gradient; wins counted per model; 'outright win' = gates passed >= competitor and higher seed-median ESS/gradient and ESS/s
versus_v1: per model and arm (owalnuts-da, owalnuts-paper, cmdstan, nutpie): seed-median v2 / v1 ratios of min bulk ESS/gradient and ESS/s from v1 summary.json; geomean over models

predictions.P1: owalnuts-da passes all gates on >= 33 of 51 cells (v1: 26)
predictions.P3: owalnuts-da geometric-mean wall per gradient <= 1.5x CmdStan's (v1: ~3x per gradient at equal counts before the STAN_THREADS fix)
predictions.P4: owalnuts-paper has no frozen cell on any model (v1: 9 models with frozen chains)
predictions.P5: zero oWALNUTS cells (any arm) lost to a fatal NaN/inf evaluation or an unevaluable start (v1: 12 cells)

decision_rules: Report all cells; no reruns; failures are results; nothing tuned after seeing results. A driver crash is relaunched and the interrupted cell re-run from scratch (seeded), recorded as a deviation.
